              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (UNKNOWN when
                it maps to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

components:

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.

          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line, and always returned.
            When the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are
            supplied they take precedence and this value is the composed,
            normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; an owner is valid
            when it supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address', plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (for example an apartment or unit). When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is converted to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0'
            is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. So
            '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Provided and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, when the city belongs to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag supplied on create. When true, the owner is allowed
            to be registered even though another owner already has the same last
            name and postcode (i.e. they share a household), and the owner is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. When absent or false, such a
            household duplicate is rejected with a 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single
                space and the last name (for example 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (UNKNOWN when
                it maps to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending
                the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household. Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner sharing a
                last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically.
                Null when the owner was created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when the owner's name
                was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a
                household of three or more members, and gains 3 for tenure over
                one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create.
                Derived from membershipPoints: level 1 (0-1 points), level 2
                (2-3 points), level 3 (4-5 points), level 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when the customerCode carries no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality carries
                no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the same day; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from whether an
                email is present. 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email, 'PHONE'
                otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64
                inclusive, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a
                create whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is
                rejected with a 409 Conflict, while any difference (a different
                telephone, email or household) is allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode with
                a different telephone; false otherwise. Always false for a declared
                household member (one created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true),
                which is not treated as a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; false for an active owner. A soft-deleted
                owner's record is retained and still readable, but it is ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
